app_fee.value: A complete degree application includes a $65 application fee.

fee_waiver.value: Application fee waivers are available only for IRT Scholars, McNair Scholars, current and former US Armed Forces members/dependents, and UMS alumni.
fee_waiver.quote:
At this time, the only application fee waiver options at the Graduate School are for the following scenarios:
IRT Scholars will receive an application fee waiver.
McNair Scholars will receive an application fee waiver.

gre_general.value: Graduate examination scores (GRE and/or GMAT) are not required by the Graduate School, but they may be required for the program to which you are applying.
gre_general.quote: Graduate examination scores (GRE and/or GMAT) are not required by the Graduate School, but they may be required for the program to which you are applying.

toefl_min.value: The Graduate School requires a minimum score of 82 on the iBT TOEFL or equivalent.
toefl_min.quote: The Graduate School requires a minimum score of 82 on the iBT TOEFL or equivalent.

ielts_min.value: The minimum IELTS score required for admission is 6.5.

english_waiver.value: An English language proficiency exam is not needed if your undergraduate (or master's) degree was taught in English or if English is an official language of your home country.
english_waiver.quote: An English language proficiency exam is not needed if your undergraduate (or master’s) degree was taught in English or if English is an official language of your home country.
